identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-R01] Retire V2 After The Rollback Window

values.goal: Remove v2 operational authority only after v3 has satisfied the approved stability window and every retained record has a terminal disposition.
values.required_outcome: deletion inventory fresh install forbidden-path scan and historical readability is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: Eligibility proof, retained importer decision, forbidden-path inventory, binary/skill/selector removal, historical evidence preservation, documentation cleanup, and final no-v2-authority verification.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-R01 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
